title: Cell vs. virus: A battle for health - Shannon Stiles
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】細胞與病毒：健康之戰－Shannon Stiles（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: You're in line at the grocery store when, uh oh, someone sneezes on you.
cues.en: You're in line at the grocery store when, uh oh, someone sneezes on you.
cues.zh: 你在超市排隊付帳，哎呀 有人對著你打噴嚏 你的肺吸進了感冒病毒

cues.text: The cold virus is sucked inside your lungs and lands on a cell on your airway lining.
cues.en: The cold virus is sucked inside your lungs and lands on a cell on your airway lining.
cues.zh: 你的肺吸進了感冒病毒 並降落在你的氣道黏膜上 地球上的每一種生物都由細胞組成

cues.text: Every living thing on Earth is made of cells, from the smallest one-celled bacteria
cues.en: Every living thing on Earth is made of cells, from the smallest one-celled bacteria
cues.zh: 地球上的每一種生物都由細胞組成 從最小的單細胞細菌 到巨大的藍鯨，還有你都是

cues.text: to the giant blue whale to you.
cues.en: to the giant blue whale to you.
cues.zh: 從最小的單細胞細菌 到巨大的藍鯨，還有你都是

cues.text: Each cell in your body is surrounded by a cell membrane, a thick flexible layer made of fats and proteins,
cues.en: Each cell in your body is surrounded by a cell membrane, a thick flexible layer made of fats and proteins,
cues.zh: 到巨大的藍鯨，還有你都是 你體內的每個細胞都以細胞膜圍住 它是肥厚可變形的層狀物 由脂肪及蛋白質組成 包圍及保護內部的元件

cues.text: that surrounds and protects the inner components.
cues.en: that surrounds and protects the inner components.
cues.zh: 包圍及保護內部的元件 它具半透性

cues.text: It's semipermeable, meaning that it lets some thing pass in and out
cues.en: It's semipermeable, meaning that it lets some thing pass in and out
cues.zh: 它具半透性 表示它讓某些物質進出 但會阻擋其他的

cues.text: but blocks others.
cues.en: but blocks others.
cues.zh: 但會阻擋其他的

cues.text: The cell membrane is covered with tiny projections.
cues.en: The cell membrane is covered with tiny projections.
cues.zh: 但會阻擋其他的 細胞膜上有很多小突起

cues.text: They all have functions, like helping cells adhere to their neighbors or binding to nutrients the cell will need.
cues.en: They all have functions, like helping cells adhere to their neighbors or binding to nutrients the cell will need.
cues.zh: 細胞膜上有很多小突起 它們都有功能 像是幫助細胞與鄰近細胞黏在一起 或是與細胞所需的營養素結合

cues.text: Animal and plant cells have cell membranes.
cues.en: Animal and plant cells have cell membranes.
cues.zh: 或是與細胞所需的營養素結合 動物及植物的細胞都有細胞膜

cues.text: Only plant cells have a cell wall, which is made of rigid cellulose that gives the plant structure.
cues.en: Only plant cells have a cell wall, which is made of rigid cellulose that gives the plant structure.
cues.zh: 動物及植物的細胞都有細胞膜 只有植物細胞有細胞壁 它是由堅硬的纖維素組成 給予植物形狀 經由噴嚏進入肺內的病毒細胞很狡猾

cues.text: The virus cell that was sneezed into your lungs is sneaky.
cues.en: The virus cell that was sneezed into your lungs is sneaky.
cues.zh: 經由噴嚏進入肺內的病毒細胞很狡猾 它假裝成朋友

cues.text: Pretending to be a friend, it attaches to a projection on the cell membrane,
cues.en: Pretending to be a friend, it attaches to a projection on the cell membrane,
cues.zh: 經由噴嚏進入肺內的病毒細胞很狡猾 它假裝成朋友 附著在細胞膜的某個突起上

cues.text: and the cell brings it through the cell membrane and inside.
cues.en: and the cell brings it through the cell membrane and inside.
cues.zh: 這個細胞就帶著它穿過細胞膜到內部 當病毒順利透過

cues.text: When the virus gets through, the cell recognizes its mistake.
cues.en: When the virus gets through, the cell recognizes its mistake.
cues.zh: 這個細胞就帶著它穿過細胞膜到內部 當病毒順利透過 細胞辨認出錯誤

cues.text: An enemy is inside!
cues.en: An enemy is inside!
cues.zh: 敵人在裡面！

cues.text: Special enzymes arrive at the scene and chop the virus to pieces.
cues.en: Special enzymes arrive at the scene and chop the virus to pieces.
cues.zh: 敵人在裡面！ 特種酵素抵達現場 把病毒大卸八塊 然後把其中一塊送回去

cues.text: They then send one of the pieces back through the cell membrane, where the cell displays it to warn neighboring cells
cues.en: They then send one of the pieces back through the cell membrane, where the cell displays it to warn neighboring cells
cues.zh: 然後把其中一塊送回去 透過細胞膜 細胞在膜上將其示眾 以警告鄰近細胞

cues.text: about the invader.
cues.en: about the invader.
cues.zh: 細胞在膜上將其示眾 以警告鄰近細胞 有入侵者

cues.text: A nearby cell sees the warning and immediately goes into action.
cues.en: A nearby cell sees the warning and immediately goes into action.
cues.zh: 鄰近的細胞看見警告 立刻做出行動

cues.text: It needs to make antibodies, proteins that will attack and kill the invading virus.
cues.en: It needs to make antibodies, proteins that will attack and kill the invading virus.
cues.zh: 它需要製造抗生素 它是蛋白質成分，會攻擊並殺掉 入侵的病毒 這個過程在細胞核內開始

cues.text: This process starts in the nucleus.
cues.en: This process starts in the nucleus.
cues.zh: 這個過程在細胞核內開始 細胞核含有我們的 去氧核糖核酸

cues.text: The nucleus contains our DNA, the blueprint that tells our cells how to make everything
cues.en: The nucleus contains our DNA, the blueprint that tells our cells how to make everything
cues.zh: 細胞核含有我們的 去氧核糖核酸 為一張藍圖，告訴我們的細胞如何製造

cues.text: our bodies need to function.
cues.en: our bodies need to function.
cues.zh: 身體所需的東西以發揮功能

cues.text: A certain section of our DNA contains instructions that tell our cells how to make antibodies.
cues.en: A certain section of our DNA contains instructions that tell our cells how to make antibodies.
cues.zh: 去氧核糖核酸的某段包含指令 告訴我們的細胞如何製造抗生素 在核內的酵素會找到 正確的那一段去氧核糖核酸

cues.text: Enzymes in the nucleus find the right section of DNA, then create a copy of these instructions,
cues.en: Enzymes in the nucleus find the right section of DNA, then create a copy of these instructions,
cues.zh: 在核內的酵素會找到 正確的那一段去氧核糖核酸 然後複製這些指令 稱做傳訊核醣核酸

cues.text: called messenger RNA.
cues.en: called messenger RNA.
cues.zh: 稱做傳訊核醣核酸 傳訊核醣核酸離開細胞核去執行指令

cues.text: The messenger RNA leaves the nucleus to carry out its orders.
cues.en: The messenger RNA leaves the nucleus to carry out its orders.
cues.zh: 傳訊核醣核酸離開細胞核去執行指令 傳訊核醣核酸前往核醣體

cues.text: The messenger RNA travels to a ribosome.
cues.en: The messenger RNA travels to a ribosome.
cues.zh: 傳訊核醣核酸離開細胞核去執行指令 傳訊核醣核酸前往核醣體

cues.text: There can be as many as 10 million ribosomes in a human cell,
cues.en: There can be as many as 10 million ribosomes in a human cell,
cues.zh: 人體細胞內有可高達一千萬個 核醣體 像釘子般綴滿一條帶狀結構

cues.text: all studded along a ribbon-like structure called the endoplasmic reticulum.
cues.en: all studded along a ribbon-like structure called the endoplasmic reticulum.
cues.zh: 核醣體 像釘子般綴滿一條帶狀結構 稱為內質網 這個核醣體讀取從細胞核傳來的指令

cues.text: This ribosome reads the instructions from the nucleus.
cues.en: This ribosome reads the instructions from the nucleus.
cues.zh: 這個核醣體讀取從細胞核傳來的指令

cues.text: It takes amino acids and links them together one by one creating an antibody protein that will go fight the virus.
cues.en: It takes amino acids and links them together one by one creating an antibody protein that will go fight the virus.
cues.zh: 這個核醣體讀取從細胞核傳來的指令 它需要胺基酸並一個個串起來 製造出抗生素蛋白質去對抗病毒 但是在此之前

cues.text: But before it can do that, the antibody needs to leave the cell.
cues.en: But before it can do that, the antibody needs to leave the cell.
cues.zh: 但是在此之前 抗生素需要離開細胞

cues.text: The antibody heads to the golgi apparatus.
cues.en: The antibody heads to the golgi apparatus.
cues.zh: 抗生素前往高基氏體 在這裡抗生素包裹起來 準備運送到細胞外

cues.text: Here, it's packed up for delivery outside the cell.
cues.en: Here, it's packed up for delivery outside the cell.
cues.zh: 在這裡抗生素包裹起來 準備運送到細胞外 包在一個跟細胞膜 同樣材料所製的泡泡裡

cues.text: Enclosed in a bubble made of the same material as the cell membrane, the golgi apparatus also gives the antibody directions,
cues.en: Enclosed in a bubble made of the same material as the cell membrane, the golgi apparatus also gives the antibody directions,
cues.zh: 包在一個跟細胞膜 同樣材料所製的泡泡裡 高基氏體也給抗生素方向 告訴它如何走到細胞的邊緣

cues.text: telling it how to get to the edge of the cell.
cues.en: telling it how to get to the edge of the cell.
cues.zh: 告訴它如何走到細胞的邊緣 當它到達那裡

cues.text: When it gets there, the bubble surrounding the antibody fuses to the cell membrane.
cues.en: When it gets there, the bubble surrounding the antibody fuses to the cell membrane.
cues.zh: 當它到達那裡 這個包圍著抗生素的泡泡 會與細胞膜融合 細胞排出抗生素

cues.text: The cell ejects the antibody, and it heads out to track down the virus.
cues.en: The cell ejects the antibody, and it heads out to track down the virus.
cues.zh: 細胞排出抗生素 而它出發向外去追捕病毒

cues.text: The leftover bubble will be broken down by the cell's lysosomes and its pieces recycled over and over again.
cues.en: The leftover bubble will be broken down by the cell's lysosomes and its pieces recycled over and over again.
cues.zh: 而它出發向外去追捕病毒 留下來的泡泡會分解 由細胞的溶酶體執行 溶掉的碎片會不斷回收利用

cues.text: Where did the cell get the energy to do all this?
cues.en: Where did the cell get the energy to do all this?
cues.zh: 細胞從何處得到能量執行這些事？ 那就是粒線體的角色了

cues.text: That's the roll of the mitochondria.
cues.en: That's the roll of the mitochondria.
cues.zh: 那就是粒線體的角色了

cues.text: To make energy, the mitochondria takes oxygen, this is the only reason we breathe it,
cues.en: To make energy, the mitochondria takes oxygen, this is the only reason we breathe it,
cues.zh: 那就是粒線體的角色了 要產生能量，粒線體需要利用氧氣 這是我們吸進氧氣的唯一理由 並從我們所吃的食物中加進電子

cues.text: and adds electrons from the food we eat to make water molecules.
cues.en: and adds electrons from the food we eat to make water molecules.
cues.zh: 並從我們所吃的食物中加進電子 以製造水分子 那個過程也產生一種高能量分子

cues.text: That process also creates a high energy molecule, called ATP which the cell uses to power all of its parts.
cues.en: That process also creates a high energy molecule, called ATP which the cell uses to power all of its parts.
cues.zh: 那個過程也產生一種高能量分子 稱為三磷酸腺苷 細胞用它提供能量給所有的零件 植物細胞以不同的方法產生能量

cues.text: Plant cells make energy a different way.
cues.en: Plant cells make energy a different way.
cues.zh: 稱為三磷酸腺苷 細胞用它提供能量給所有的零件 植物細胞以不同的方法產生能量 它們有葉綠體

cues.text: They have chloroplasts that combine carbon dioxide and water with light energy from the sun
cues.en: They have chloroplasts that combine carbon dioxide and water with light energy from the sun
cues.zh: 它們有葉綠體 能結合二氧化碳及水 藉助從太陽得來的光能

cues.text: to create oxygen and sugar, a form of chemical energy.
cues.en: to create oxygen and sugar, a form of chemical energy.
cues.zh: 產生氧氣及糖 為化學能的一種形式 細胞內的所有零件都必須合作

cues.text: All the parts of a cell have to work together to keep things running smoothly,
cues.en: All the parts of a cell have to work together to keep things running smoothly,
cues.zh: 為化學能的一種形式 細胞內的所有零件都必須合作 讓一切運作順利 你身體的所有細胞也都必須合作

cues.text: and all the cells of your body have to work together to keep you running smoothly.
cues.en: and all the cells of your body have to work together to keep you running smoothly.
cues.zh: 你身體的所有細胞也都必須合作 讓你運作順利 那是一大堆的細胞

cues.text: That's a whole lot of cells.
cues.en: That's a whole lot of cells.
cues.zh: 那是一大堆的細胞

cues.text: Scientists think there are about 37 trillion of them.
cues.en: Scientists think there are about 37 trillion of them.
cues.zh: 科學家認為大約有 37 兆個！
